## Execution tips

- Adjust the gripper to the block's current rotation and close on flat areas in the middle of a pair of opposite faces, away from corners, to reduce slipping or rotation during grasping.
- Set the opening slightly wider than the distance between the selected opposite faces. When approaching from above, confirm that the fingers are on opposite sides of the block and the pads can contact the sides effectively; leave clearance between the fingertips and table.
